responsibility: Implements GCC’s tree-based field-sensitive points-to analysis by translating GIMPLE into inclusion constraints and solving them. It creates constraint variables for pointers and aggregate fields, builds direct/copy/complex constraints and copy graphs, performs cycle elimination and substitution, propagates solutions to derive per-SSA and per-symbol points-to sets, and in IPA mode computes call-clobber/use summaries for direct and indirect calls so the alias oracle and other optimizers can consume precise pointer and memory-side-effect information.
